title: Harnessing bound states in the continuum for quantum and nonlinear photonics in silicon nitride microresonators
summary: In this work we theoretically and experimentally investigate bound states in the continuum (BICs) in a reconfigurable integrated photonic structure, focusing on spontaneous four-wave mixing. We consider a configuration in which only one mode, the idler, is tuned to the BIC condition, and show that suppressing the radiative loss of this single mode profoundly reshapes the overall nonlinear dynamics.
